designs.selection_rule: Freeze group-isolated val/test once; select nested train groups for 30/60/84 without moving any holdout group.
designs.interpretation: Only 120 total acquisitions are required before group-rounding; 84 is the maximum training budget, not 120.

designs.selection_rule: Acquire independent val/test groups in addition to the 120-acquisition training pool; never reuse them to reach a training budget.
designs.interpretation: The arithmetic minimum is 120+18+18=156 total acquisitions; indivisible subject/acquisition groups can require more than 156.

split_protocol.isolation_unit: source acquisition plus all cameras, clips, transcodes, aliases and windows
split_protocol.group_rounding_rule: Keep every group whole and report actual train/val/test counts; do not split a group to hit exact ratios.
split_protocol.test_subject_requirement: Use multiple test subjects and preferably multiple sources; one-subject val or test cannot support a broad cross-subject claim.
split_protocol.previously_seen_test_policy: Any previously inspected test group is development data, not a new unseen test group.

baselines.name: majority_class
baselines.fit: Compute each head's majority class from valid train targets only; keep the same fitted baseline for val/test.

baselines.name: persistent_interaction
baselines.rule: Copy the last observed valid subject/object/interaction state; use the protocol's explicit none fallback when no prior state exists.

training_protocol.invalid_label_policy: Mask label_valid=0 targets from loss, class distributions and metrics; pending or unlabelled frames are not none.
training_protocol.test_policy: Do not inspect test predictions or metrics until all budgets, hyperparameters, checkpoints and the final val-selected configuration are frozen; run the final test evaluation exactly once.

evaluation_protocol.selection_tie_break: Prefer the smaller training budget, then the simpler baseline/model according to the frozen ordering; never consult test.
evaluation_protocol.final_test_use: Report the single val-selected final configuration with class distribution and acquisition-cluster confidence intervals.

metrics.three_head_joint_accuracy: A target is correct only when subject, object and interaction_type are all correct on the same valid target.

sample_weighted.description: Pool every valid target frame with equal weight; this is descriptive because windows within an acquisition are correlated.

acquisition_equal_weight.description: Give every independent acquisition equal weight regardless of its window count.
acquisition_equal_weight.confusion_matrix: Within each acquisition divide every confusion count by that acquisition's valid target count, then average the normalized matrices over acquisitions; compute F1 and joint accuracy from the aggregated matrices.
acquisition_equal_weight.class_support: Report both valid target frames and the number of independent acquisitions containing each class.

cluster_bootstrap.small_cluster_warning: If val/test has only one subject or very few acquisition clusters, label intervals unstable and limit the conclusion; do not replace clusters with windows.

plateau_rule.rule: A terminal plateau requires the final adjacent-budget gain to be <=0.01 and its paired acquisition-cluster bootstrap 95% CI to include 0. A whole-curve plateau requires every adjacent-budget gain to meet both conditions.
plateau_rule.otherwise: Report no_plateau_evidence_or_inconclusive rather than guaranteeing more data will help.

learning_curve.required_result: Report plateau status per model and aggregation, with every adjacent-budget gain and CI; current status is not computable without predictions.

scarcity_rule.rule: Flag zero-support classes separately; flag nonzero support below either floor as scarce. These are project diagnostic floors, not sufficiency guarantees.

class_diagnostics.failure_rule: For every supported class report precision/recall/F1 and confusion; flag zero recall and F1 below both non-learning baselines. Do not hide absent or rare classes inside overall accuracy.

required_inputs: accepted per-class events and valid target supports
acquisition-level outcome variance and the effect size to detect
seed-level and acquisition-cluster results from the frozen protocol
statistical_power_and_accuracy.rule: Do not invent event counts, power, effect sizes, confidence intervals or final accuracy; windows cannot increase the effective independent sample size.

required_outputs.prohibition: No test-based selection of budget, model, checkpoint, hyperparameters, normalization or plateau conclusion.
